name: broadcastrelay
description: Docker relay for church streaming: takes the feed from OBS (SRT, RTMP, WHIP) or an NDI source, sends a separate encode to YouTube, Facebook and other destinations, serves a web player (WebRTC on the LAN, HLS for the public), records the raw input, publishes the feed as NDI, and is controlled from a web page and Bitfocus Companion
author: Jerod Ulicki
